newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firmer with gas oil but swaps ease.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firmer with gas oil but swaps ease.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were about $4 a tonne firmer on Wednesday, keeping pace with the IPE gas oil contract, but weaker swaps values reflected a softer underlying tone, dealers said.
Feb cif cargo swaps traded at Feb IPE +$33.25 a tonne, $1 weaker than on Tuesday, they said.
"There is definitely a softer tone. There will be plenty of material available in the middle of February," said one, pointing to the open arbitrage from the Mediterranean to NWE.
Most interest was for small parcels into the U.K. but few cif barrels were being shown, given high freight rates.
"The shipping shortage is still stifling most activity," said a trader.
Premiums for spot cargoes and barges were valued unchanged at Feb IPE +$27 and +$29/$30 a tonne fob ARA, dealers said.
